flexor-pollicis-longus.name: Flexor Pollicis Longus
flexor-pollicis-longus.origin: Anterior surface of radius, interosseous membrane
flexor-pollicis-longus.insertion: Base of distal phalanx of thumb
flexor-pollicis-longus.action: Flexion of thumb IP joint, assists thumb MCP flexion

adductor-pollicis.name: Adductor Pollicis
adductor-pollicis.origin: Oblique head: capitate, 2nd-3rd metacarpal bases; Transverse head: 3rd metacarpal shaft
adductor-pollicis.insertion: Medial side of proximal phalanx of thumb via medial sesamoid
adductor-pollicis.action: Thumb adduction, assists thumb flexion at MCP

latissimus-dorsi.name: Latissimus Dorsi
latissimus-dorsi.origin: Spinous processes T7-L5, posterior iliac crest, thoracolumbar fascia, inferior angle of scapula
latissimus-dorsi.insertion: Floor of bicipital groove of humerus
latissimus-dorsi.action: Extension, adduction, internal rotation; depressor (particularly during abduction)

levator-scapulae.name: Levator Scapulae
levator-scapulae.origin: Posterior tubercles of C1-C4 transverse processes
levator-scapulae.insertion: Superior angle and medial border of scapula
levator-scapulae.action: Scapular elevation; assists cervical lateral flexion and rotation
levator-scapulae.innervation: Dorsal scapular nerve (C5) and direct branches from C3-C4 cervical plexus
levator-scapulae.blood_supply: Dorsal scapular artery, transverse cervical artery

rectus-femoris.name: Rectus Femoris
rectus-femoris.origin: Anterior inferior iliac spine (straight head) and ilium above acetabulum (reflected head)
rectus-femoris.insertion: Patella via quadriceps tendon, then tibial tuberosity via patellar ligament

diaphragm.name: Diaphragm
diaphragm.origin: Xiphoid process, costal cartilages of ribs 7-12, lumbar vertebrae (crura attach to L1-L3)
diaphragm.action: Respiration (primary), increases intra-abdominal pressure, contributes to spinal stabilization by increasing intervertebral stiffness
diaphragm.blood_supply: Phrenic arteries, musculophrenic arteries, lower posterior intercostal arteries

vastus-lateralis.name: Vastus Lateralis
vastus-lateralis.origin: Lateral lip of linea aspera, greater trochanter, intertrochanteric line
vastus-lateralis.insertion: Patella (lateral aspect) via quadriceps tendon; consists of superficial, intermediate, and deep layers
vastus-lateralis.action: Knee extension; acts as general joint stabilizer with activation independent of moment direction

sternocleidomastoid.name: Sternocleidomastoid
sternocleidomastoid.origin: Sternal head: manubrium; Clavicular head: medial third of clavicle
sternocleidomastoid.action: Bilateral: cervical flexion; Unilateral: ipsilateral lateral flexion, contralateral rotation
sternocleidomastoid.innervation: Cranial nerve XI (spinal accessory nerve) with contributions from C2-C3
sternocleidomastoid.blood_supply: Superior thyroid artery, occipital artery, suprascapular artery

flexor-carpi-ulnaris.name: Flexor Carpi Ulnaris
flexor-carpi-ulnaris.origin: Medial epicondyle (humeral head), olecranon and posterior ulna (ulnar head)
flexor-carpi-ulnaris.insertion: Pisiform, hook of hamate, base of 5th metacarpal

infraspinatus.name: Infraspinatus
infraspinatus.action: External rotation, horizontal extension; arm elevation (particularly in posterior planes)
infraspinatus.blood_supply: Suprascapular artery, posterior circumflex humeral artery

supinator.name: Supinator
supinator.origin: Lateral epicondyle of humerus, supinator crest of ulna
supinator.innervation: Deep branch of radial nerve (C5, C6)

adductor-magnus.name: Adductor Magnus
adductor-magnus.origin: Adductor portion: inferior pubic ramus and ischial ramus; Hamstring portion: ischial tuberosity
adductor-magnus.insertion: Adductor portion: linea aspera; Hamstring portion: adductor tubercle of femur
adductor-magnus.action: Adduction; adductor portion also flexes and internally rotates; hamstring portion extends and externally rotates
adductor-magnus.innervation: Dual innervation: adductor portion receives both posterior branch of obturator nerve (L2-L4) and tibial portion of sciatic nerve (L4-S1) in >90% of cases; hamstring portion receives tibial nerve
adductor-magnus.blood_supply: Medial circumflex femoral artery, perforating branches of profunda femoris

suboccipitals.name: Suboccipital Muscles
suboccipitals.origin: Rectus capitis posterior major: spinous process of C2; Rectus capitis posterior minor: posterior tubercle of C1; Obliquus capitis superior: transverse process of C1; Obliquus capitis inferior: spinous process of C2
suboccipitals.insertion: Rectus major: lateral inferior nuchal line; Rectus minor: medial inferior nuchal line; Obliquus superior: between superior and inferior nuchal lines; Obliquus inferior: transverse process of C1
suboccipitals.action: Extension of head (all except obliquus inferior); ipsilateral rotation (rectus major, obliquus inferior â€” obliquus inferior accounts for ~70% of C1-C2 rotation); lateral flexion (obliquus superior); proprioceptive feedback for head position
suboccipitals.innervation: Suboccipital nerve (dorsal ramus of C1) for all four muscles
suboccipitals.blood_supply: Muscular branches of vertebral and occipital arteries

quadriceps.name: Quadriceps Femoris
quadriceps.origin: Rectus femoris: AIIS (straight head) and ilium above acetabulum (reflected head); Vasti: various surfaces of femoral shaft
quadriceps.insertion: Patella via quadriceps tendon, then tibial tuberosity via patellar ligament
quadriceps.action: Knee extension; rectus femoris also assists hip flexion
quadriceps.blood_supply: Lateral femoral circumflex artery, femoral artery branches

trapezius-middle.name: Middle Trapezius
trapezius-middle.insertion: Medial acromion, superior spine of scapula
trapezius-middle.innervation: Spinal accessory nerve (CN XI), with proprioceptive and motor contributions from C3-C4

semispinalis-thoracis.name: Semispinalis Thoracis
semispinalis-thoracis.action: Bilateral: thoracic and cervical extension; Unilateral: contralateral rotation
semispinalis-thoracis.innervation: Medial branches of posterior rami of thoracic spinal nerves
semispinalis-thoracis.blood_supply: Posterior intercostal arteries, deep cervical artery (upper portions)

palmaris-longus.name: Palmaris Longus
palmaris-longus.origin: Medial epicondyle via anterior common tendon
palmaris-longus.action: Weak wrist flexion, tenses palmar aponeurosis
palmaris-longus.blood_supply: Branches from median nerve artery and ulnar artery

posterior-deltoid.name: Posterior Deltoid
posterior-deltoid.action: Horizontal abduction, extension; antagonist to elevation in anterior arm positions
posterior-deltoid.innervation: Axillary nerve (anterior branch in 91.5% of cases, posterior branch in 8.5%)

biceps-femoris-short.name: Biceps Femoris â€” Short Head
biceps-femoris-short.origin: Lateral lip of linea aspera, lateral supracondylar line
biceps-femoris-short.insertion: Head of fibula (joins long head tendon)
biceps-femoris-short.innervation: Common fibular (peroneal) division of sciatic nerve (L5-S2); single branch
biceps-femoris-short.blood_supply: Perforating branches of profunda femoris artery

splenius-cervicis.name: Splenius Cervicis
splenius-cervicis.insertion: Posterior tubercles of C1-C3 transverse processes
splenius-cervicis.action: Bilateral: cervical extension; Unilateral: ipsilateral rotation and lateral flexion
splenius-cervicis.innervation: Dorsal rami of lower cervical spinal nerves (C5-C7)

multifidus.name: Multifidus
multifidus.origin: Posterior sacrum, superior iliac spine, mammillary processes of lumbar vertebrae, lateral sacral crest, thoracolumbar fascia (pennate bundle)
multifidus.insertion: Spinous processes of lumbar vertebrae, typically 2-4 levels above
multifidus.action: Segmental stabilization of the lumbar spine, extension, rotation control
multifidus.innervation: Medial branches of lumbar dorsal rami (L1-L5); each medial branch innervates only fascicles arising from the spinous process with the same segmental number
multifidus.blood_supply: Lumbar arteries (segmental branches from abdominal aorta)

external-intercostals.name: External Intercostals
external-intercostals.origin: Inferior border of rib above (from tubercle to costochondral junction)
external-intercostals.action: Inspiratory in dorsal portions; rib elevation at end-expiratory volume; mechanical advantage greatest in dorsal rostral interspaces

pronator-quadratus.name: Pronator Quadratus
pronator-quadratus.innervation: Anterior interosseous nerve (branch of median nerve, C7-C8)

quadratus-femoris.name: Quadratus Femoris
quadratus-femoris.insertion: Intertrochanteric crest and quadrate tubercle of femur
quadratus-femoris.blood_supply: Inferior gluteal artery, medial circumflex femoral artery

opponens-pollicis.name: Opponens Pollicis
opponens-pollicis.action: Opposition of thumb (flexion + medial rotation of 1st metacarpal)
opponens-pollicis.blood_supply: Superficial palmar branch of radial artery

extensor-pollicis-brevis.name: Extensor Pollicis Brevis
extensor-pollicis-brevis.insertion: Dorsal base of proximal phalanx of thumb
extensor-pollicis-brevis.action: Extension of thumb MCP and CMC joints, mild abduction

brachialis.name: Brachialis
brachialis.origin: Anterior surface of distal half of humerus
brachialis.insertion: Superficial head: ulnar tuberosity via thick tendon; Deep head: coronoid process via aponeurosis
brachialis.action: Elbow flexion (primary pure flexor, unaffected by forearm position)
brachialis.innervation: Musculocutaneous nerve (C5-C6) to superficial head; radial nerve contribution to deep head (83.33% of cases)

tibialis-anterior.name: Tibialis Anterior
tibialis-anterior.origin: Lateral tibial condyle, upper two-thirds of lateral tibial surface, interosseous membrane
tibialis-anterior.insertion: Medial cuneiform and base of 1st metatarsal

flexor-carpi-radialis.name: Flexor Carpi Radialis
flexor-carpi-radialis.origin: Medial epicondyle of humerus (common flexor origin)

scalenes.name: Scalene Muscles
scalenes.origin: Anterior: anterior tubercles C3-C6; Middle: posterior tubercles C2-C7; Posterior: posterior tubercles C5-C7
scalenes.insertion: Anterior: first rib (scalene tubercle); Middle: first rib (posterior to subclavian groove); Posterior: second rib (outer surface)
scalenes.action: Cervical flexion (anterior), lateral flexion, ipsilateral rotation; rib elevation during inspiration
scalenes.innervation: Anterior: anterior rami C4-C6; Middle: anterior rami C3-C8; Posterior: anterior rami C6-C8

extensor-digitorum-longus.name: Extensor Digitorum Longus
extensor-digitorum-longus.origin: Lateral tibial condyle, fibula, interosseous membrane
extensor-digitorum-longus.insertion: Middle and distal phalanges of toes 2-5

peroneus-longus.name: Peroneus Longus (Fibularis Longus)
peroneus-longus.origin: Head and upper two-thirds of lateral fibula
peroneus-longus.insertion: Base of 1st metatarsal and medial cuneiform (plantar surface)
peroneus-longus.action: Foot eversion, assists plantarflexion, supports transverse arch

gluteus-medius.name: Gluteus Medius
gluteus-medius.origin: Gluteal fossa (between anterior and posterior gluteal lines), gluteal aponeurosis, posteroinferior edge of iliac crest
gluteus-medius.insertion: Lateral and superoposterior facets of greater trochanter via lateral and posterior tendon parts
gluteus-medius.action: Anterior fibers: abduction and internal rotation; middle fibers: abduction; posterior fibers: abduction and external rotation; primary hip stabilizer during initial gait phase and pelvic rotation
gluteus-medius.innervation: Superior gluteal nerve (L4-S1) with 3-4 branches supplying different muscle regions

gracilis.name: Gracilis
gracilis.origin: Body and inferior ramus of pubis
gracilis.insertion: Medial surface of proximal tibia (pes anserinus)
gracilis.action: Hip adduction, knee flexion, knee internal rotation
gracilis.blood_supply: Main pedicle from medial femoral circumflex or profunda femoris (~10 cm from origin); 1-3 distal branches from superficial femoral artery

flexor-digitorum-profundus.name: Flexor Digitorum Profundus
flexor-digitorum-profundus.origin: Proximal three-quarters of anterior and medial ulna, interosseous membrane
flexor-digitorum-profundus.insertion: Bases of distal phalanges of fingers 2-5
flexor-digitorum-profundus.action: Flexion of DIP joints (primary), assists PIP and MCP flexion and wrist flexion
flexor-digitorum-profundus.innervation: Lateral half: anterior interosseous nerve (C7, C8); Medial half: ulnar nerve (C8, T1)

tibialis-posterior.name: Tibialis Posterior
tibialis-posterior.origin: Posterior tibia, fibula, and interosseous membrane
tibialis-posterior.insertion: Navicular tuberosity and plantar surfaces of cuneiforms and metatarsals 2-4
tibialis-posterior.action: Foot inversion, assists plantarflexion, supports medial longitudinal arch

palmar-interossei.name: Palmar Interossei
palmar-interossei.insertion: Extensor expansions and proximal phalanges of fingers 2, 4, 5
palmar-interossei.action: Finger adduction (MCP), assist MCP flexion and IP extension

splenius-capitis.name: Splenius Capitis
splenius-capitis.origin: Lower half of nuchal ligament and spinous processes of C7-T3
splenius-capitis.insertion: Mastoid process and lateral superior nuchal line
splenius-capitis.action: Bilateral: cervical extension; Unilateral: ipsilateral rotation and lateral flexion
splenius-capitis.innervation: Dorsal rami of middle cervical spinal nerves (C3-C5)

vastus-intermedius.name: Vastus Intermedius
vastus-intermedius.origin: Anterior and lateral surface of femoral shaft
vastus-intermedius.insertion: Patella (deep layer) via quadriceps tendon; forms complex multi-layered structure with VM
vastus-intermedius.innervation: Femoral nerve (L2-L4), with medial portions sharing innervation with VM

flexor-digitorum-longus.name: Flexor Digitorum Longus
flexor-digitorum-longus.action: Toe flexion (DIP toes 2-5), assists ankle plantarflexion

flexor-hallucis-longus.name: Flexor Hallucis Longus
flexor-hallucis-longus.action: Great toe flexion (IP), assists ankle plantarflexion

adductor-longus.name: Adductor Longus
adductor-longus.blood_supply: Medial circumflex femoral artery, obturator artery

brachioradialis.name: Brachioradialis
brachioradialis.origin: Proximal two-thirds of lateral supracondylar ridge of humerus
brachioradialis.insertion: Lateral aspect of distal radius (styloid process)
brachioradialis.action: Elbow flexion (most effective in neutral forearm), assists pronation from supinated and supination from pronated position
brachioradialis.blood_supply: Radial recurrent artery, radial artery branches

opponens-digiti-minimi.name: Opponens Digiti Minimi
opponens-digiti-minimi.origin: Flexor retinaculum and hook of hamate
opponens-digiti-minimi.action: Opposition of 5th digit (flexion and rotation at CMC)

gluteus-minimus.name: Gluteus Minimus
gluteus-minimus.origin: Gluteal fossa (between anterior and inferior gluteal lines)
gluteus-minimus.insertion: Anterior facet of greater trochanter and hip joint capsule
gluteus-minimus.action: Hip abduction, internal rotation; primary hip stabilizer during mid- and late gait cycle
gluteus-minimus.innervation: Superior gluteal nerve (L4-S1) with distinct secondary nerve branches entering four muscle regions

semitendinosus.name: Semitendinosus
semitendinosus.origin: Ischial tuberosity (conjoint tendon with biceps femoris long head)
semitendinosus.insertion: Medial surface of proximal tibia (pes anserinus)
semitendinosus.action: Knee flexion, hip extension, knee internal rotation
semitendinosus.innervation: Tibial division of sciatic nerve (L5-S2); always 2 branches (superior and inferior)
semitendinosus.blood_supply: Perforating branches of profunda femoris artery, superficial femoral artery branches

vastus-medialis.name: Vastus Medialis
vastus-medialis.origin: Medial lip of linea aspera, intertrochanteric line
vastus-medialis.insertion: VML inserts at base of patella; VMO inserts at medial margin of patella; extensive insertion into vastus intermedius aponeurosis
vastus-medialis.action: Knee extension; VMO contributes to medial patellar tracking

sartorius.name: Sartorius
sartorius.insertion: Medial surface of proximal tibia (pes anserinus)
sartorius.action: Hip flexion, hip external rotation, hip abduction; knee flexion
sartorius.blood_supply: Multiple vascular pedicles (average 6-7) from femoral artery

gemelli.name: Gemellus Superior and Inferior
gemelli.origin: Superior: ischial spine; Inferior: ischial tuberosity
gemelli.insertion: Medial surface of greater trochanter (via obturator internus tendon complex)
gemelli.innervation: Superior: nerve to obturator internus (L5-S1); Inferior: nerve to quadratus femoris (L4-S1)

upper-trapezius.name: Upper Trapezius
upper-trapezius.origin: External occipital protuberance, medial superior nuchal line, ligamentum nuchae, C7 spinous process
upper-trapezius.action: Scapular elevation, cervical extension, ipsilateral lateral flexion, contralateral rotation
upper-trapezius.innervation: Spinal accessory nerve (CN XI), with proprioceptive and motor contributions from C3-C4

trapezius-upper.name: Upper Trapezius
trapezius-upper.origin: External occipital protuberance, medial superior nuchal line, ligamentum nuchae, C7 spinous process
trapezius-upper.action: Scapular elevation, upward rotation; draws scapula backward; raises scapula by rotating clavicle
trapezius-upper.innervation: Spinal accessory nerve (CN XI), with proprioceptive and motor contributions from C3-C4

extensor-digitorum.name: Extensor Digitorum
extensor-digitorum.origin: Lateral epicondyle of humerus (common extensor origin)
extensor-digitorum.action: Extension of MCP joints of fingers 2-5; assists wrist extension

internal-oblique.name: Internal Oblique
internal-oblique.origin: Thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest, lateral two-thirds of inguinal ligament
internal-oblique.insertion: Lower ribs (10-12), linea alba, pubic crest
internal-oblique.action: Ipsilateral trunk rotation, lateral flexion, trunk flexion; highest activity during IAP generation tasks
internal-oblique.innervation: Thoracolumbar nerves (T6-L1), with 10th intercostal nerve providing a median of 9 branches
internal-oblique.blood_supply: Lower posterior intercostal arteries, deep circumflex iliac artery, deep inferior epigastric artery

triceps-brachii.name: Triceps Brachii
triceps-brachii.origin: Long head: infraglenoid tubercle; Lateral head: posterior humerus (above radial groove); Medial head: posterior humerus (below radial groove)
triceps-brachii.action: Elbow extension; long head assists shoulder extension
triceps-brachii.blood_supply: Deep brachial artery, posterior circumflex humeral artery

external-oblique.name: External Oblique
external-oblique.insertion: Linea alba, pubic tubercle, anterior half of iliac crest
external-oblique.action: Contralateral trunk rotation, ipsilateral lateral flexion, trunk flexion, core stabilization
external-oblique.blood_supply: Lower posterior intercostal arteries, subcostal artery, deep circumflex iliac artery

soleus.name: Soleus
soleus.origin: Posterior surface of fibular head, proximal tibia (soleal line)
soleus.action: Ankle plantarflexion (especially during slow/postural activities); selectively activated with knee extension
soleus.blood_supply: Posterior tibial artery, peroneal artery (dual supply)

anterior-deltoid.name: Anterior Deltoid
anterior-deltoid.action: Arm elevation (particularly in anterior planes), horizontal flexion
anterior-deltoid.blood_supply: Thoracoacromial artery, anterior circumflex humeral artery

erector-spinae.name: Erector Spinae Group
erector-spinae.origin: Iliocostalis lumborum: ilium, erector spinae aponeurosis, L1-4 transverse/accessory processes; Longissimus thoracis: ilium, lumbar intermuscular aponeurosis, erector spinae aponeurosis
erector-spinae.insertion: Iliocostalis: costal elements of L1-4, lower ribs; Longissimus: accessory and transverse processes of lumbar vertebrae, lower thoracic vertebrae and ribs
erector-spinae.action: Bilateral: trunk extension, maintains upright posture; Unilateral: lateral flexion; portions have appreciable potential to generate torque about all three orthopedic axes
erector-spinae.innervation: Iliocostalis: lateral branches of lumbar dorsal rami; Longissimus: intermediate branches of lumbar dorsal rami

obturator-internus.name: Obturator Internus
obturator-internus.origin: Inner surface of obturator membrane and surrounding pelvic bone
obturator-internus.insertion: Medial surface of greater trochanter (forms continuum with gemelli)

flexor-pollicis-brevis.name: Flexor Pollicis Brevis
flexor-pollicis-brevis.origin: Superficial head: flexor retinaculum, trapezium; Deep head: trapezoid, capitate
flexor-pollicis-brevis.insertion: Lateral side of proximal phalanx of thumb via lateral sesamoid
flexor-pollicis-brevis.action: Flexion of thumb MCP joint, assists opposition
flexor-pollicis-brevis.innervation: Superficial head: median nerve (C8, T1); Deep head: ulnar nerve (C8, T1)
flexor-pollicis-brevis.blood_supply: Superficial palmar branch of radial artery

pronator-teres.name: Pronator Teres
pronator-teres.origin: Medial epicondyle of humerus (humeral head), coronoid process of ulna (ulnar head)
pronator-teres.insertion: Middle of lateral surface of radius
pronator-teres.blood_supply: Ulnar artery, anterior ulnar recurrent artery

popliteus.name: Popliteus
popliteus.action: Knee internal rotation, 'unlocking' the knee from full extension, posterolateral stabilization
popliteus.innervation: Tibial nerve (L4-S1); 90% tibial nerve alone, 10% tibial and sciatic
popliteus.blood_supply: Inferior medial genicular artery (90%), posterior tibial artery (65%)

rectus-abdominis.name: Rectus Abdominis
rectus-abdominis.insertion: Costal cartilages of ribs 5-7, xiphoid process
rectus-abdominis.action: Trunk flexion, posterior pelvic tilt, compression of abdominal contents
rectus-abdominis.innervation: Thoracolumbar nerves (T6-L1), with a constant branch from L1; umbilicus always innervated by T10
rectus-abdominis.blood_supply: Superior epigastric artery, inferior epigastric artery, lower posterior intercostal arteries

rotatores-thoracis.name: Rotatores (Thoracis)
rotatores-thoracis.insertion: Lamina and base of spinous process of vertebra 1-2 segments superior
rotatores-thoracis.innervation: Medial branches of posterior rami of thoracic spinal nerves

extensor-carpi-ulnaris.name: Extensor Carpi Ulnaris
extensor-carpi-ulnaris.origin: Lateral epicondyle and posterior ulnar border

subscapularis.name: Subscapularis
subscapularis.action: Internal rotation, adduction; superior portion contributes to arm elevation and horizontal flexion; inferior portion primarily horizontal flexion and internal rotation
subscapularis.blood_supply: Subscapular artery, anterior circumflex humeral artery, posterior circumflex humeral artery

abductor-digiti-minimi.name: Abductor Digiti Minimi
abductor-digiti-minimi.insertion: Ulnar base of 5th proximal phalanx and extensor expansion

dorsal-interossei.name: Dorsal Interossei (Hand)
dorsal-interossei.origin: Adjacent sides of two metacarpals each
dorsal-interossei.insertion: Lateral sides of proximal phalanges and extensor expansions of fingers 2-4
dorsal-interossei.action: Finger abduction (MCP), assist MCP flexion and IP extension

biceps-femoris-long.name: Biceps Femoris â€” Long Head
biceps-femoris-long.insertion: Head of fibula, lateral tibial condyle
biceps-femoris-long.action: Knee flexion, hip extension, knee external rotation
biceps-femoris-long.innervation: Tibial division of sciatic nerve (L5-S2); typically 1-2 branches
biceps-femoris-long.blood_supply: Perforating branches of profunda femoris artery

lumbricals.name: Lumbricals (Hand)
lumbricals.insertion: Lateral sides of extensor expansions of fingers 2-5
lumbricals.action: MCP flexion with simultaneous IP extension (lumbrical position)
lumbricals.innervation: Lateral two: median nerve (C8, T1); Medial two: ulnar nerve (C8, T1)
lumbricals.blood_supply: Superficial palmar arch, common palmar digital arteries

abductor-pollicis-longus.name: Abductor Pollicis Longus
abductor-pollicis-longus.origin: Posterior radius, ulna, and interosseous membrane
abductor-pollicis-longus.insertion: Radial base of 1st metacarpal (may have slips to trapezium and APB)
abductor-pollicis-longus.action: Radial abduction and extension at CMC; important in wrist radial deviation

extensor-pollicis-longus.name: Extensor Pollicis Longus
extensor-pollicis-longus.origin: Middle third of posterior ulna, interosseous membrane
extensor-pollicis-longus.insertion: Base of distal phalanx of thumb
extensor-pollicis-longus.action: Extension of thumb IP and MCP joints, assists wrist extension and thumb adduction

pectineus.name: Pectineus
pectineus.insertion: Pectineal line of femur (posterior to lesser trochanter)
pectineus.action: Hip flexion, adduction; hip stabilizer during rotational movements
pectineus.innervation: Femoral nerve (L2-L3), may receive accessory innervation from obturator nerve
pectineus.blood_supply: Medial circumflex femoral artery, obturator artery

semimembranosus.name: Semimembranosus
semimembranosus.insertion: Posterior medial tibial condyle with multiple expansions
semimembranosus.action: Knee flexion, hip extension, knee internal rotation
semimembranosus.innervation: Tibial division of sciatic nerve (L5-S2); usually single branch
semimembranosus.blood_supply: Perforating branches of profunda femoris artery

adductor-group.name: Adductor Group (Longus/Brevis/Magnus)
adductor-group.origin: Pubic bone (various surfaces for each muscle)
adductor-group.insertion: Linea aspera of femur (longus/brevis); linea aspera and adductor tubercle (magnus)
adductor-group.action: Hip adduction; magnus also assists hip extension and flexion depending on fiber direction
adductor-group.innervation: Obturator nerve (L2-L4); hamstring portion of magnus: tibial nerve (L4-S1)
adductor-group.blood_supply: Medial circumflex femoral artery, obturator artery, perforating branches of profunda femoris

extensor-carpi-radialis-brevis.name: Extensor Carpi Radialis Brevis
extensor-carpi-radialis-brevis.origin: Lateral epicondyle via long, wide tendinous origin on anterior slope

teres-minor.name: Teres Minor
teres-minor.action: External rotation, horizontal extension; antagonist to elevation

anconeus.name: Anconeus
anconeus.action: Elbow extension assist, dynamic stabilization of ulnohumeral joint
anconeus.innervation: Radial nerve (triceps-anconeus branch); double innervation from posterior interosseous nerve branch in 70.4%
anconeus.blood_supply: Interosseous recurrent artery, middle collateral artery

supraspinatus.name: Supraspinatus
supraspinatus.action: Initiates abduction; biphasic function (horizontal extensor/internal rotator in anterior planes; horizontal flexor/external rotator in posterior planes)
supraspinatus.blood_supply: Suprascapular artery, acromial branch of thoracoacromial artery, anterior circumflex humeral artery

plantaris.name: Plantaris
plantaris.origin: Lateral supracondylar line of femur, oblique popliteal ligament
plantaris.action: Weak knee flexion, weak ankle plantarflexion

iliopsoas.name: Iliopsoas
iliopsoas.origin: Iliacus: iliac fossa, anterior sacroiliac ligament; Psoas major: transverse processes, vertebral bodies, and intervertebral discs of T12-L5
iliopsoas.insertion: Lesser trochanter of femur; psoas tendon inserts separately from iliacus into crest running from superior to anterior aspect of lesser trochanter
iliopsoas.action: Hip flexion (primary); psoas also assists lumbar spine flexion; iliacus can selectively stabilize pelvis during contralateral hip extension
iliopsoas.innervation: Iliacus: femoral nerve (L2-L4); Psoas: ventral rami L1-L4, with L2-L3 branches most robust; nerve branches commonly cross L2-3, L3-4, L4-5 discs obliquely
iliopsoas.blood_supply: Lumbar arteries, iliolumbar artery, deep circumflex iliac artery

serratus-anterior.name: Serratus Anterior
serratus-anterior.insertion: Medial border of scapula (upper part: superior angle; middle part: medial border; lower part: inferior angle)
serratus-anterior.action: Scapular protraction, upward rotation, posterior tilt, external rotation; stabilizes medial border and prevents winging
serratus-anterior.innervation: Long thoracic nerve (C5-C7; upper part mainly C5, middle and lower parts C6-C7)

semispinalis-cervicis.name: Semispinalis Cervicis
semispinalis-cervicis.innervation: Dorsal rami of cervical and upper thoracic spinal nerves

tensor-fasciae-latae.name: Tensor Fasciae Latae
tensor-fasciae-latae.origin: Anterior superior iliac spine (ASIS) and outer lip of iliac crest
tensor-fasciae-latae.action: Hip flexion, abduction, internal rotation; tenses the fascia lata
tensor-fasciae-latae.blood_supply: Ascending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery

gluteus-maximus.name: Gluteus Maximus
gluteus-maximus.origin: Posterior gluteal line of ilium, dorsal surface of sacrum and coccyx, sacrotuberous ligament
gluteus-maximus.insertion: Superior three-fourths: gluteal tuberosity of femur via plate-like distal tendon, with partial adhesions to iliotibial tract; inferior portion: lateral femoral intermuscular septum complex
gluteus-maximus.action: Hip extension, external rotation; upper fibers assist abduction, lower fibers assist adduction

adductor-brevis.name: Adductor Brevis
adductor-brevis.origin: Anteroinferior aspect of pubic body and inferior pubic ramus
adductor-brevis.insertion: Proximal linea aspera and pectineal line
adductor-brevis.blood_supply: Medial circumflex femoral artery, obturator artery

abductor-pollicis-brevis.name: Abductor Pollicis Brevis
abductor-pollicis-brevis.insertion: Lateral side of proximal phalanx of thumb
abductor-pollicis-brevis.blood_supply: Superficial palmar branch of radial artery

transversus-abdominis.name: Transversus Abdominis
transversus-abdominis.origin: Lateral third of inguinal ligament, iliac crest, thoracolumbar fascia, costal cartilages of ribs 7-12
transversus-abdominis.insertion: Linea alba, pubic crest, conjoint tendon; vertical dimension attaching to lumbar spine via thoracolumbar fascia averages 5.2 cm
transversus-abdominis.action: Increases intra-abdominal pressure, trunk stabilization, compression of abdominal contents
transversus-abdominis.innervation: Thoracolumbar nerves (T6-L1), traveling within the transversus abdominis plane (TAP)
transversus-abdominis.blood_supply: Lower posterior intercostal arteries, subcostal artery, deep circumflex iliac artery, deep inferior epigastric artery

gastrocnemius.name: Gastrocnemius
gastrocnemius.origin: Medial head: posterior surface of medial femoral condyle; Lateral head: posterior surface of lateral femoral condyle

pectoralis-major.name: Pectoralis Major
pectoralis-major.origin: Clavicular head: medial half of clavicle; Sternal head: sternum and costal cartilages 1-6
pectoralis-major.insertion: Lateral lip of bicipital groove (clavicular head: anterior lamina; sternal head: posterior lamina)
pectoralis-major.action: Clavicular head: horizontal adduction, flexion, internal rotation; Sternal head: adduction, horizontal adduction, extension from flexed position, internal rotation
pectoralis-major.innervation: Clavicular head: lateral pectoral nerve (C5-C7); Sternal head: medial and lateral pectoral nerves (C6-T1)
pectoralis-major.blood_supply: Thoracoacromial artery, lateral thoracic artery, internal thoracic artery

deep-cervical-flexors.name: Deep Cervical Flexors
deep-cervical-flexors.origin: Longus colli: anterior tubercles C3-C5 (superior oblique), bodies C5-T3 (vertical), transverse processes C5-C6 (inferior oblique); Longus capitis: anterior tubercles C3-C6 transverse processes
deep-cervical-flexors.insertion: Longus colli: anterior tubercle of C1 atlas (superior oblique), bodies C2-C4 (vertical), bodies C5-C6 (inferior oblique); Longus capitis: basilar part of occipital bone (inferior surface)
deep-cervical-flexors.action: Craniocervical flexion (capitis at C0-C1), cervical flexion (colli at C2-C3), segmental cervical stabilization
deep-cervical-flexors.innervation: Longus colli: anterior rami C1-C6; Longus capitis: anterior rami C1-C5
deep-cervical-flexors.blood_supply: Segmental branches of ascending cervical artery

quadratus-lumborum.name: Quadratus Lumborum
quadratus-lumborum.action: Lateral flexion, 12th rib stabilization during inspiration; modest direct action on lumbar spine (<10% of extensor/lateral bending moments)
quadratus-lumborum.innervation: Ventral rami of T12-L4, with motor neurons in both ventromedial and lateromedial nuclei
quadratus-lumborum.blood_supply: Lumbar arteries, subcostal artery, iliolumbar artery

teres-major.name: Teres Major
teres-major.origin: Inferior angle and lower lateral border of scapula
teres-major.insertion: Medial lip of intertubercular groove of humerus
teres-major.action: Internal rotation, adduction, extension of the shoulder

biceps-brachii.name: Biceps Brachii
biceps-brachii.origin: Long head: supraglenoid tubercle; Short head: coracoid process of scapula
biceps-brachii.action: Elbow flexion, forearm supination, weak shoulder flexion

semispinalis-capitis.name: Semispinalis Capitis
semispinalis-capitis.insertion: Between superior and inferior nuchal lines of occipital bone
semispinalis-capitis.action: Bilateral: cervical and head extension; Unilateral: ipsilateral lateral flexion
semispinalis-capitis.innervation: Dorsal rami of cervical spinal nerves (C1-C6)

piriformis.name: Piriformis
piriformis.action: External rotation, abduction (particularly with hip in slight extension); hip stabilization

flexor-digiti-minimi-brevis.name: Flexor Digiti Minimi Brevis
flexor-digiti-minimi-brevis.origin: Flexor retinaculum and hook of hamate

internal-intercostals.name: Internal Intercostals
internal-intercostals.origin: Superior border and costal groove of rib below (from sternum to angle of rib)
internal-intercostals.action: Interosseous portions: expiratory (caudal interspaces); Parasternal portions: inspiratory; action depends on rib cage volume and interspace location

rhomboid-major.name: Rhomboid Major
rhomboid-major.insertion: Medial border of scapula (between spine and inferior angle)

obturator-externus.name: Obturator Externus
obturator-externus.origin: Outer surface of obturator membrane and pubic ramus
obturator-externus.blood_supply: Obturator artery, medial circumflex femoral artery

trapezius-lower.name: Lower Trapezius
trapezius-lower.innervation: Spinal accessory nerve (CN XI), with proprioceptive and motor contributions from C3-C4
trapezius-lower.blood_supply: Dorsal scapular artery, transverse cervical artery

extensor-hallucis-longus.name: Extensor Hallucis Longus
extensor-hallucis-longus.action: Great toe extension, assists ankle dorsiflexion

flexor-digitorum-superficialis.name: Flexor Digitorum Superficialis
flexor-digitorum-superficialis.origin: Medial epicondyle, coronoid process, anterior radius
flexor-digitorum-superficialis.action: Flexion of PIP joints, assists MCP and wrist flexion

peroneus-brevis.name: Peroneus Brevis (Fibularis Brevis)
peroneus-brevis.blood_supply: Peroneal artery, anterior tibial artery branch

hamstrings.name: Hamstrings (Group)
hamstrings.origin: Ischial tuberosity (long heads); biceps short head: lateral lip of linea aspera
hamstrings.insertion: Biceps: head of fibula; Semimembranosus: posterior medial tibial condyle; Semitendinosus: pes anserinus
hamstrings.action: Knee flexion, hip extension; medial hamstrings assist internal rotation of knee; biceps assists external rotation
hamstrings.innervation: Tibial division of sciatic nerve (L5-S2) for long heads and medial hamstrings; common fibular division for biceps short head
hamstrings.blood_supply: Perforating branches of profunda femoris artery

middle-deltoid.name: Middle Deltoid
middle-deltoid.action: Primary abductor (35-65% contribution to abduction torque, particularly in posterior planes and higher elevation angles)
middle-deltoid.blood_supply: Thoracoacromial artery, posterior circumflex humeral artery
